lines.text: Don't paste that contract into ChatGPT yet.

lines.text: Why not? It's just a client contract.

lines.text: With their name, their rates and your signature.

directions: on screen: Settings > Data controls > "Improve the model for everyone" {{verify wording and default}}

lines.text: Then your boss wins. Company policy beats any setting.

lines.text: So I'll remove the names first?

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: Names, numbers, anything you wouldn't email a stranger.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Side hustle 52: reading the contract before I paste it.
